title: Package Alias Resolution Flow
interaction_flow: Installer → RepositorySet: createPool(request, io) — triggers alias-aware pool creation
RepositorySet → PoolBuilder: buildPool(repositories, request)
PoolBuilder → ArrayRepository: loadPackages(packageNameMap, acceptableStabilities, stabilityFlags, alreadyLoaded)
ArrayRepository → ArrayRepository: getPackages() — returns stored BasePackage/AliasPackage list
ArrayRepository: if AliasPackage matched → also adds getAliasOf() base package to result set
ArrayRepository: second pass — adds AliasPackages whose aliasOf is in results (even if alias didn't match)
PoolBuilder → PoolBuilder: loadPackage(request, repositories, package, propagateUpdate)
PoolBuilder: stores package at packages[indexCounter++]
PoolBuilder: if package is AliasPackage → aliasMap[spl_object_hash(aliasOf)][index] = aliasPackage
PoolBuilder: if rootAliases[name][version] exists and propagateUpdate → create root alias wrapper
PoolBuilder → BasePackage: getAliasOf() — unwrap nested AliasPackage to get basePackage
PoolBuilder: if basePackage instanceof CompletePackage → new CompleteAliasPackage(basePackage, alias_normalized, alias)
PoolBuilder: else → new AliasPackage(basePackage, alias_normalized, alias)
PoolBuilder → AliasPackage: setRootPackageAlias(true)
AliasPackage.__construct → BasePackage.__construct(aliasOf.getName())
AliasPackage.__construct → VersionParser: parseStability(version) — sets stability and dev flag
AliasPackage.__construct: foreach Link::$TYPES as type → links = aliasOf.get{Type}()
AliasPackage.__construct → AliasPackage: replaceSelfVersionDependencies(links, type)
AliasPackage.replaceSelfVersionDependencies: if prettyVersion == DEFAULT_BRANCH_ALIAS → use aliasOf.getPrettyVersion()
AliasPackage.replaceSelfVersionDependencies: for conflict/provide/replace links with self.version → append new Link(source, target, Constraint('=', version))
AliasPackage.replaceSelfVersionDependencies: for require/devRequire links with self.version → replace link in-place, set hasSelfVersionRequires=true
AliasPackage.replaceSelfVersionDependencies → Link: new Link(source, target, Constraint('=', this.version), linkType, prettyVersion)
PoolBuilder → PoolBuilder: stores aliasPackage at packages[newIndex], registers in aliasMap
RepositorySet.createPoolWithAllPackages: iterates repositories → for each package checks rootAliases[name][version]
RepositorySet: unwraps existing AliasPackage via getAliasOf() → creates CompleteAliasPackage or AliasPackage
RepositorySet → AliasPackage: setRootPackageAlias(true), appends to packages list
RepositorySet → Pool: new Pool(packages) — final pool with base packages + alias wrappers
ArrayRepository.addPackage: if package is AliasPackage and aliasOf has no repository → recursively addPackage(aliasOf)
key_relationships: CompleteAliasPackage composes CompletePackage (aliasOf field, narrowed type)
AliasPackage delegates most getters to aliasOf (getType, getAutoload, getSourceType, etc.)
AliasPackage overrides: getVersion, getStability, getPrettyVersion, isDev, getRequires, getDevRequires, getConflicts, getProvides, getReplaces
PoolBuilder depends_on AliasPackage + CompleteAliasPackage for root alias wrapping
RepositorySet depends_on PoolBuilder for pool construction
ArrayRepository stores both base packages and AliasPackage instances
ArrayRepository.createAliasPackage: unwraps nested aliases via while(instanceof AliasPackage) loop before wrapping

self_version_substitution.for_conflict_provide_replace: appends new Link with Constraint('=', aliasVersion) — keeps original link too
self_version_substitution.for_require_dev_require: replaces link in-place; sets hasSelfVersionRequires=true on alias package
self_version_substitution.version_used: this.prettyVersion, but if DEFAULT_BRANCH_ALIAS then aliasOf.getPrettyVersion()

branch_alias_wrapping.source: extra['branch-alias'] in package metadata (processed upstream by loader/repository)
branch_alias_wrapping.root_alias_flag: setRootPackageAlias(true) — used by DefaultPolicy for sorting (issue #576)
branch_alias_wrapping.aliasMap: PoolBuilder.aliasMap[spl_object_hash(basePackage)][index] = aliasPackage — for cleanup on package removal

important_notes: AliasPackage wraps a BasePackage to present a different version while delegating all non-version data to the aliasOf. CompleteAliasPackage adds CompletePackageInterface delegation (scripts, license, keywords, etc.). ArrayRepository.loadPackages performs two passes: first selects matched packages + their aliasOf base, then adds all AliasPackages whose base was selected. PoolBuilder.loadPackage creates root alias wrappers on-the-fly when rootAliases match. Nested AliasPackages are always unwrapped (getAliasOf()) before creating a new alias wrapper.
